item.title: Virginia Beach mom charged with fraud after claiming daughter was injured by metal in potato chips
item.description: A Virginia Beach mother is facing fraud charges after state police say she submitted falsified medical docs while seeking compensation for her daughter's alleged injury from metal found in a chip bag.

item.title: Short wrestling career ends up life-changing for Tallwood's McKnight
item.description: Wrestling runs in Destiny McKnight's family. Her father wrestled and it was something she'd always wanted to try, but had never hit the mat herself.

item.title: Fresh off win No. 250, Norfolk State's Jones eyes more hardware for the Spartans
item.description: Robert Jones doesn't know each and every milestone that's approaching when it comes to his career, but he was aware of this one.
